question: The value of (1)/(2²)+(1)/(2³) div((1)/(2)+(1)/(2) div 1) + 3 (1)/(3) div (5)/(2) times (3)/(4) div 6 (2)/(3) times (7)/(6) is:
solution:
**Given:**

The value of dfrac{1}{2²}+dfrac{1}{2³} div (dfrac{1}{2}+dfrac{1}{2} div 1) + 3 (1)/(3) div (5)/(2) times (3)/(4) div 6 (2)/(3) times (7)/(6)

**Formula used:**

Apply basic arithmetic operations and simplification rules.

**Calculation:**

dfrac{1}{2²}+dfrac{1}{2³} div (dfrac{1}{2}+dfrac{1}{2} div 1) + 3 (1)/(3) div (5)/(2) times (3)/(4) div 6 (2)/(3) times (7)/(6)

First, simplify each part separately:

dfrac{1}{2²} = dfrac{1}{4}

dfrac{1}{2³} = dfrac{1}{8}

dfrac{1}{2} + dfrac{1}{2} div 1 = dfrac{1}{2} + dfrac{1}{2} = 1

3 (1)/(3) div (5)/(2) = (10)/(3) times (2)/(5) = (4)/(3)

(3)/(4) div 6 (2)/(3) = (3)/(4) times (3)/(20) = (9)/(80)

(4)/(3) times (9)/(80) times (7)/(6) = (7)/(40)

Combining the parts:

((1)/(4) + (1)/(8) div 1 + (7)/(40))

((1)/(4) + (1)/(8) + (7)/(40))

Find a common denominator (LCM of 4, 8, 40):

((10+5+7)/(40))

⇒ 22 / 40

⇒ 11 / 20 

**∴ The correct answer is option (3).**
